baseline_models.mechanism: The ruler moves Joseph out of common availability into an exclusive personal and institutional relation.

activation_trace.role: Specialization away from shared claim supplies the exclusive transfer into the ruler's immediate service.
The self or very person locates the selection in the king's own sphere rather than in a generic court office.
Sovereignty makes the personal selection an act with institutional force.

changed_reading.before: The king merely orders Joseph to be brought to court.
changed_reading.after: The summons initiates an exclusive transfer into the ruler's own trusted decision sphere.

baseline_models.mechanism: Arrival and extraction can be read as a release trajectory nested inside recruitment: Joseph is brought through and out of something that had held him.

activation_trace.role: Coming and arrival supply the directed movement toward the king.
Escape from an entanglement supplies a release vector within the act of selecting.

changed_reading.before: The command is only a change of workplace or patron.
changed_reading.after: The command can also mark passage out of an ensnaring condition and into a new relation.

baseline_models.mechanism: An intelligible two-party exchange is the threshold after which the ruler issues an effective status declaration.

activation_trace.role: Mutually intelligible speech supplies direct interpersonal testing rather than mere physical presentation.
A speaker whose word takes effect supplies the royal utterance that converts the exchange into status.

changed_reading.before: Conversation is a narrative pause before two compliments.
changed_reading.after: Direct conversation functions as an assessment, and the following royal speech enacts its result.

baseline_models.mechanism: The paired predicates impose two distinct conditions for delegated agency: operative capacity and relational trust.

activation_trace.role: Empowerment and ability supply the capacity to act effectively.
Security and confidence supply the trust that bounds and licenses that capacity.

changed_reading.before: The final adjectives are cumulative praise.
changed_reading.after: They are a two-axis qualification: empowered enough to act and trusted enough to be empowered.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prior confinement makes the release sense of extraction concrete, while exclusive selection names its destination; the focus changes Joseph's institutional custody rather than merely adding honor.

activation_trace.role: Release from what has caught or held someone supplies the outward vector of the transition.
Exclusive specialization supplies the new relation into which the released person moves.
Confinement in a holding place supplies the concrete institutional enclosure from which the focus extracts Joseph.

structural_cues: Confinement recurs before the focus, while the focus moves in one sequence from bringing Joseph to placing him 'with us'.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies confinement, directed arrival, extraction, and royal proximity; I infer a transformation of custody, while the live simpler alternative is release followed by an unrelated appointment.

changed_reading.before: A lexical possibility of release accompanies selection.
changed_reading.after: The selection is a concrete transfer from carceral holding to entrusted royal proximity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier requests for a clarifying judgment turn the direct conversation into an assessment of already demonstrated interpretive and advisory competence.

activation_trace.role: Intelligible exchange supplies the immediate setting in which competence can be tested firsthand.
Giving a determining answer supplies the known competence carried into the royal conversation.
The split mapped root independently preserves clarification of judgment as the trigger rather than collapsing the occurrence to youth.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from a requested determination and its answer to the king's direct conversation with the answerer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior adjudicative answering and later direct speech; I infer an interview-like test of transferable competence, while courtly welcome remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The king learns Joseph's quality only during an unspecified conversation.
changed_reading.after: The conversation tests in person a capacity already manifested through decisive interpretation and counsel.

context_deltas.mechanism: A chain of failed remembrance and messenger relay is replaced by unmediated speech, so the king's conclusion rests on firsthand encounter rather than transmitted reputation.

activation_trace.role: Directly connecting speakers supplies the endpoint that removes prior mediation.
Recall after absence supplies the fragile memory channel through which access was first sought.
Loss of remembrance supplies the failure and delay of that indirect channel.
The messenger and message supply the remaining relay immediately before direct access.

structural_cues: Remembering, forgetting, and messenger movement precede the focus's explicit face-to-face speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a delayed memory route, messenger relay, and direct exchange; I infer an epistemic shift from report to firsthand judgment, while the sequence may also be ordinary narrative staging.

changed_reading.before: The speech scene simply confirms what the king has heard.
changed_reading.after: It replaces unreliable and mediated knowledge with a direct basis for royal trust.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding emergence and establishment of truth activates extraction as purification after admixture: selection follows the public separation of Joseph from contaminating accusation.

activation_trace.role: Purification after mixture supplies the focus's movement from contested status to cleared status.
Truthfulness of speech supplies the positive content separated from accusation.
Truth becoming exposed supplies the public disclosure phase of the clearing mechanism.
Establishing and making truth manifest supplies institutional confirmation before selection.

structural_cues: The truth declaration and confession occur immediately before the focus's extraction and trust language.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies public truth disclosure followed by extraction; I infer that clearance is a condition of legitimate incorporation, while usefulness alone could still explain the king's choice.

changed_reading.before: The king privately chooses a useful man.
changed_reading.after: The king incorporates a publicly cleared man whose status has been purified from accusation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The denial of betrayal precisely when conduct is hidden gives the final trust predicate a tested relational content.

activation_trace.role: Security and confidence supply the positive designation of a person safe to entrust.
Deficiency in fidelity supplies the exact negative counterpart that the focus's trust designation excludes.
Hiddenness from observers supplies the condition under which fidelity has evidentiary force.

structural_cues: A statement of non-betrayal in absence directly precedes the king's declaration of trust.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden conduct, non-betrayal, and the later trust predicate; I infer a criterion-to-verdict relation, while immediate juxtaposition need not prove the king explicitly reasoned through that criterion.

changed_reading.before: Trustworthy is a broad honorific based on favorable impression.
changed_reading.after: Trustworthy names reliability under non-observation, demonstrated by the absence of betrayal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following request operationalizes the capacity-trust pair as empowered placement over guarded resources; the adjectives become a blueprint for office rather than detached praise.

activation_trace.role: Empowerment supplies the authority side of the prospective office.
Entrustable security supplies the fiduciary side of the prospective office.
Causing someone to occupy a state supplies the requested conversion of qualification into appointment.
A custodian charged with keeping supplies supplies the concrete administrative function.
Vigilant attentiveness supplies the control discipline required alongside authority.

structural_cues: The focus's paired predicates are immediately followed by a request for placement over stored resources.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies capacity, trust, custodianship, and requested placement; I infer a qualification-to-office blueprint, while Joseph's proposal could be a new initiative rather than an unpacking of the king's words.

changed_reading.before: The king grants court standing and expresses personal confidence.
changed_reading.after: The king identifies the paired competencies that can support delegated resource governance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next movement from being established 'with us' to taking a place where desired makes royal proximity a platform for distributed agency, not a new enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Empowerment supplies the capacity released by proximity to the royal center.
Taking a place supplies the later spatial range that the focus's standing enables.

structural_cues: The next ayah repeats the empowerment motif and expands it into movement through the land.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies royal standing followed by broad place-taking; I infer that central proximity licenses geographic agency, while the two may simply be successive benefits.

changed_reading.before: Being 'with us' sounds like privileged but court-bound closeness.
changed_reading.after: Closeness to the center becomes the authorization from which wide operational freedom proceeds.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the royal first-person possessive as governance of the ruler's own decision center; it remains anchored in 'for myself' and 'trustworthy' plus the nearby non-exonerating, commanding self, and downstream prose should mark it as an abductive institutional-psychological possibility rather than the construction's sole sense.

activation_trace.role: The inward faculty of reason supplies the king's own decision center as the possible destination of selection.
A person who induces security supplies a possible counterweight within that decision center.
Refusal of absolute self-clearance supplies the need for guarded rather than naive confidence in one's own interior.
The self as a disposition and force supplies the internal pressure that may require trustworthy counsel.
Demand and compulsion supply the directional pressure attributed to the self in the preceding ayah.

changed_reading.before: The king wants Joseph for personal possession or service.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the king recruits a trustworthy counterweight into the very center from which his own will issues.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the wound branch inside the speech root; it remains anchored in the focus verb of speaking and the nearby reopened cut-hand affair, and downstream prose should present it as a cross-domain resonance of speech touching stigma, not as a replacement translation of the verb.

Intelligible speech keeps the model anchored in the actual conversational construction.
Cutting and separation supply the concrete wound imagery reopened during the investigation before the focus.

changed_reading.before: The king's conversation only transmits information about Joseph.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, direct speech crosses the still-visible wound of accusation and reclassifies the marked person as trusted.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant split mapping of the repeated speech root; it remains anchored in the two occurrences that frame Joseph's movement into standing, and downstream prose must identify it as a form-distant mapped resonance, not claim that the ordinary speech verb lexically means rising or instability.

activation_trace.role: Carrying, rising, and standing independently supply an exploratory upward transition bracketed by the two speech acts.

Established rank supplies the stable endpoint of the form-distant movement.

changed_reading.before: The two sayings merely frame a summons and response.
changed_reading.after: At the split-root resonance level, they frame a lift from unstable dependency into independent standing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it imports the fracture-repair branch of reward into the temporal force of 'today'; it remains anchored in the focus's eventful day and established status plus the next ayah's non-loss of recompense, and downstream prose should qualify it as material analogy rather than direct lexical equivalence.

activation_trace.role: A day as a consequential event supplies the hinge on which status changes.
Loss and disappearance supply the outcome explicitly denied for prior good work.
Setting a fracture supplies the material analogy by which new standing repairs a long-dislocated public position.

changed_reading.before: Today marks the immediate date of promotion.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, today is the repair hinge where work that was not lost is converted into a straightened public standing.

strongest_changes: Extraction becomes both release from confinement and exclusive incorporation into royal proximity.
Direct conversation becomes a firsthand assessment after failed memory, messenger relay, and demonstrated judgment.
Publicly emerged truth and non-betrayal in absence give purification and trust concrete evidentiary content.
The capacity-trust pair becomes an office blueprint, while later spatial agency prevents royal proximity from reading as a new enclosure.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports coexisting institutional, relational, spatial, and psychological readings: personal selection can be liberation, proximity can enable range, and trust can describe both proven fidelity and a counterweight inside power. Split-root and cross-domain branches preserve additional form-distant activations without displacing the ordinary constructions.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus does not disclose the content of the direct conversation, so its interview function remains inferred.
Public clearance may be a prerequisite for selection or only the immediately preceding narrative condition.
The self-counterweight, wound, split-root stabilization, and fracture-repair readings are deliberately exploratory.
The later office request may unpack the king's predicates or may be Joseph's independent specification of a role.
